meta.name: HB Destockage brand tokens
meta.consumer: packages/ui-tokens (tokens.css + TS export). Values here are the source of truth; ui-tokens transcribes them.
meta.reference: docs/design-reference/DESIGN.md (apple-com): light surfaces, near-black text, one blue accent, generous space. Where the reference and CLAUDE.md budgets disagree, the budgets win.
meta.format: Each leaf is { "$value", "$type", "$description"? } in the spirit of the W3C Design Tokens draft. Colours are 6-digit hex (sRGB) unless they carry alpha.
meta.contrastCheck: node brand/scripts/contrast.mjs [--out file]  (verifies every entry of contrastPairs; exits 1 on any failure). Tests: node --test brand/test/*.test.mjs

surface.$description: Page background, cards on surface-alt, inputs.

surface-alt.$description: Alternate section band, product-image well, footer top. Apple fill-tertiary.

surface-raised.$description: Cards and dialogs that sit on surface-alt.

surface-inverse.$description: Rare dark band (footer bottom, toast). Only text-inverse / text-inverse-secondary / accent-inverse on it.

text.$description: Body copy, headings, prices. Apple glyph-gray.

text-secondary.$description: Captions, hints, meta, struck compare-at price. >= 4.5:1 on surface AND surface-alt (Apple's #86868b fails, so it is not used for text).

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent / accent-hover fills (primary button).

border.$description: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (1px). Not for form-control boundaries: below 3:1.

border-control.$description: Input, select, checkbox and secondary-button outlines. >= 3:1 on surface and surface-alt (WCAG 1.4.11).

accent.$description: The single brand accent: primary button fill (order CTA), selected variant ring, focus ring, active nav underline. Same blue as the reference.

accent-hover.$description: Hover/pressed fill of accent. Darker (not lighter, as on apple.com) so on-accent text keeps >= 4.5:1.

accent-text.$description: Accent used as TEXT (inline links, text buttons). accent itself is only 4.31:1 on surface-alt, so links use this.

accent-surface.$description: Very light accent tint: info notes, selected list row.

focus.$description: Focus ring: outline 2px solid, offset 2px. >= 3:1 against surface, surface-alt and surface-inverse.

success.$description: In-stock text, order confirmed. Text and icon colour.

success-surface.$description: Background of success notes and badges.

warning.$description: Low stock ('only 3 left'), delivery unavailable notice. Text and icon colour.

danger.$description: Form validation errors, out of stock. Always paired with an icon + text, never colour alone.

danger-surface.$description: Background of the error summary box.

price.$description: Regular price. Prices read as calm text, not as alarms.

sale.$description: Discounted price and the discount badge text. Deeper than danger so a sale never reads as an error.

contrastPairs.$description: Every text/background or UI/background pair the storefront may use. min 4.5 = normal text (WCAG 1.4.3), 3 = large text (>= 24px, or >= 18.66px bold — Arabic is never bold here, so Arabic text always needs 4.5 below 24px) or non-text UI (1.4.11). Using a pair not listed here requires adding it and re-running the check.

pairs.use: body text in alt band / image well

latin.$value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, "Noto Sans", "Liberation Sans", sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
latin.$description: French pages and all Latin UI. 0 bytes: SF Pro on Apple, Roboto on Android, Segoe UI on Windows. No Latin webfont (CLAUDE.md budget).

arabic.$value: "HB Noto Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Arabic", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Tahoma, sans-serif
arabic.$description: Arabic pages. First entry = the self-hosted static Noto Sans Arabic 400 subset (packages/ui-tokens owns the file and @font-face: font-display optional, preload on /ar/ only, unicode-range Arabic). Fallbacks are system fonts (Noto Naskh on Android, SF Arabic on iOS, Segoe UI on Windows).

switcher.$description: The «العربية» language-switch label on /fr/ pages. Must not name the webfont, so French pages never download it through unicode-range.

numeric.$description: Prices and phone numbers use the page font with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (system fonts and Noto Sans Arabic both support it).

regular.$description: The ONLY weight for Arabic text (one static file). Latin body.

emphasis.$description: Latin headings, price, button labels — system fonts only. Under :lang(ar) every weight resolves to 400 and font-synthesis is none, so the browser never fakes bold Arabic.

synthesis.$description: font-synthesis: none on :lang(ar). Arabic hierarchy = size + colour + space, never weight.

latin-ui.$description: Unitless. Buttons, chips, nav, one-line labels.

arabic-body.$description: Unitless, explicit (CLAUDE.md: 1.6–1.8). Prevents layout shift between the webfont and the system fallback (their natural line-heights range 1.20–2.11em).

arabic-heading.$description: Unitless. Arabic headings, display and one-line UI labels. Lower bound of the CLAUDE.md range; Arabic ascenders/descenders need it.

arabic-ui.$description: Unitless. Buttons, chips, nav in Arabic.

latin-display.$description: Latin display and h1 only (system fonts tighten at large sizes, as on the reference).

latin-caps.$description: Small uppercase eyebrows in French only (e.g. 'NOUVEAUTÉS'). Arabic has no case: eyebrows in Arabic use text-secondary colour instead.

arabic.$description: ALWAYS 0 on Arabic. Reset letter-spacing: 0 under :lang(ar) — spacing breaks cursive joins.

typeScale.$description: Modular scale, fluid between 360px and 1440px viewports. Ratio 1.2 (minor third) at 360, 1.25 (major third) at 1440, base 16 → 17px. Sizes rounded to whole px. Same steps for Arabic and Latin (Noto Sans Arabic's large x-height reads well at equal size); Arabic never goes below 14px except the caption step on single short labels.

measure.$description: Max line length for running text (content pages, product description).

space.$description: 4px base, 8px rhythm. Use logical properties only (margin-inline-start, padding-block, inset-inline-*).

section-block.$description: Vertical padding between home/category sections — the reference's generous air.

header-height.$description: Sticky header (reference 44px; raised for 44px tap targets with padding). scroll-padding-block-start = header-height + space.2.

bottom-bar-height.$description: Sticky mobile order bar on the product page. scroll-padding-block-end = this + space.2.

tap-min.$description: Minimum hit area for every interactive element (CLAUDE.md).

breakpoint.$description: Mobile-first min-width queries. Design at 360, verify 768 and 1440.

lg.$description: Product cards, image wells, dialogs (reference cards ~18px).

pill.$description: Buttons (primary + secondary), search field, language switch.

shadow.$description: Minimal. Depth comes from surface vs surface-alt, not shadows. Nothing at rest on cards.

hover.$description: Product card on hover (pointer: fine only).

sticky.$description: Sticky header / bottom bar edge once scrolled; reads as a hairline.

control.$description: Input outline (border-control colour). 2px accent when selected; 2px danger when invalid.

motion.$description: CSS only (View Transitions, @starting-style, transitions). Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every duration becomes 0.01ms and the view-transition animation is disabled; nothing auto-advances.

base.$description: Dialog/popover in, accordion, cross-document view transition.

slow.$description: Hero image fade-in on load (opacity only). Max anywhere.

distance.$description: Max translate for entrance motion. Use translate on the block axis or inline axis via logical direction (mirror in RTL).

overlay.$description: Dialog scrim + dialog (top layer covers most cases).

icon.$description: Direction for packages/ui-tokens/icons (tokens owns the set; brand guide documents it).

stroke.$description: Outline icons, round caps and joins, stroke=currentColor, fill none. Matches the thin, crisp reference glyphs.

sizes.$description: Rendered at 20 in UI text, 24 in header/buttons, 16 inline in captions. Hit area always >= tap-min.

mirror.$value: Directional icons (arrows, chevrons, back, send, cart-with-motion) carry data-mirror and flip under [dir=rtl] with transform: scaleX(-1). Non-directional (search, phone, check, close, WhatsApp, truck) never mirror.
